title: Six ways to draw you, the opening told by the cast, and the room's verdict
headline: Three things to look at. The designer drew six options of you as the narrator (attached). The storyteller wrote the opening pages as the cast's script, with an interview and a therapy session (attached, a draft for your read). And six fictional readers like the Vibathon room read the ten pages: all read to the end, all would start with the one page of rules, and all said 'maybe' for one reason: step one has no 'how'.

for_you.ask: Which of the six is you? (one, or two to combine)
for_you.detail: A: the brief and a pen. B: on stage, headset and clicker. C: a map in hand. D: the usage dial at 95%. E: a goalpost under one arm (the bible's kind joke: he moves the goalposts). F: one of the team, a screen for a face. No likeness is guessed; the options differ only in what you hold or wear. Your card reads three numbers from the register.

for_you.ask: Read the opening pages told by the cast (draft attached)
for_you.detail: Your voice the default, the agents in turn; every scene banded as dramatised and resting on the record; the interview (the researcher and the deck, on the claims that did not hold) and the therapy session (the conductor after the hold, to security's empty chair). Your own failures are in your voice.

for_you.ask: For your title thread: the second name round
for_you.detail: N8 'Brakes So We Can Go Faster' first for five of eight personas, N7 'Agents That Work Together' for two. The journalist's warning: N8 claims the brakes made the speed, so the book must earn it. Weigh both against PS1 (the factory).

for_you.ask: The developer's session keeps restarting (three wakes cut off today)
for_you.detail: A new session for the role (H1), with its status and debrief as the handover, as it suggests.

sections.title: What stalled the readers (for the rewrite)
items: step one ('make an account', 'an empty repository') with no how
the claim codes in the middle of sentences; the story wants them in the online layer
conductor, wake, hold and Wardley maps used before they are explained
a command and a commit hash on the page, which made three feel the book assumes they code
the series paragraph: one reader found it delayed the point, another read it as 'hustle tone'
